title: buildstock-corpus release sections
description: Every heading of every document in one dataset release, with its level, the 1-based line range it spans in the processed markdown file (line 1 is the provenance header), and, for every H2 and the preamble, the section file that holds it. Keyed by corpus path. Generated by `bsc map`; stamps the manifest it describes.

documents.description: corpus_path -> the document's headings in file order.

line_end.description: Last line before the next heading of any level, or the file's last line.

file.description: Section file holding this heading and everything beneath it down to the next H2: every H2 has one; the H1 names the 00- preamble file when there is text before the first H2. Relative to processed/<product>/<release>/. Absent for H3 and deeper.
